title: People on two public payrolls: not testable from these files
question: Is anyone paid by two San Francisco public employers in the same year?
finding: Not testable. The 76 State Controller files saved list positions and pay but no names or employee numbers, so no person can be followed from one employer to another.
how: Every column of the raw export was checked: year, employer, department, position, salary range, pay columns, benefits, pension formula and employer details. None identifies a person.
limits: A test would need the named payrolls of each employer (the City publishes names; the school district, City College, BART and the bridge district would have to be asked).

rows.item: Columns in the export: Year, EmployerType, EmployerName, DepartmentOrSubdivision, Position, ElectedOfficial, Judicial, OtherPositions, MinPositionSalary, MaxPositionSalary, ReportedBaseWage, RegularPay, OvertimePay, LumpSumPay, OtherPay, TotalWages, DefinedBenefitPlanContribution, EmployeesRetirementCostCovered, DeferredCompensationPlan, HealthDentalVision, TotalRetirementAndHealthContribution, PensionFormula, EmployerURL, EmployerPopulation, LastUpdatedDate, EmployerCounty, SpecialDistrictActivities, IncludesUnfundedLiability, SpecialDistrictType
rows.result: none names a person or carries an employee number

sources.t: California State Controller: Government Compensation in California, raw exports 2019 to 2025
